newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thailand's PTT issues tender to buy Aug fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's PTT issues tender to buy Aug fuel oil.

text.p: State-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) has issued a tender to buy 80,000 tonnes of fuel oil for August 15-25 delivery to Sri Racha, a PTT source said on Monday.
The tender seeks 75,000 tonnes of 180-centistoke grade, 2.0 percent sulphur and 5,000 tonnes of 180-centistoke, 1.0 percent fuel oil. It closes on July 1 and offers will be valid until July 2.
The source said PTT issued the spot tender because "the term contracts could not fulfill our demand. We need more cargoes."
The fuel oil is used for power generation.
